sentences.en: My mum helps me remove the core of the plum.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈帮我去掉李子的核。

sentences.en: The shiny purple plums were already ripened on the tree.
sentences.zh: 那些亮紫色的李子已经在树上成熟了。

sentences.en: We visited Mito Park, which is famous for its plum blossoms.
sentences.zh: 我们参观了以梅花著名的水户公园。

senses.zh: 人所希望的；有利的；上等的
